question: Does the exact equality f105^*Z ~= f81^*Z of the pulled-back H=(Z/2)^2 torsors impose a simultaneous Nielsen/fundamental-group obstruction beyond the exact-W and transvection conditions already charged in EX1-05O?

parent_05v.exact_use: The degree-105 ramification totals are individually Hurwitz-realizable for all r; low total ramification does not force small monodromy. Separate Nielsen data do not yet encode the common D marking.

relative_v4_source_note.exact_use: The lift through the relative H-isomorphism torsor gives f1^*Z ~= f2^*Z and hence equality f1^*alpha_chi=f2^*alpha_chi for every character chi of H. W=image(H^*->H^1(C2,F2)) has dimension two.

exact_W_adapter.exact_use: The exact marked plane W is two-dimensional and the pointwise condition T|W=id and T^dagger|W=id leaves 16 Q602 mod-2 operator residues.

transvection.exact_use: Additional marked Weierstrass geometry refines the 16 exact-W operators to residues 73,97,235. 05W must not recharge that transvection.

torsor_H1_classification.exact_use: For an abelian sheaf H, isomorphism classes of H-torsors are canonically classified by H^1(-,H).

torsor_class_exactness.character_recovery: Because H=F2^2 and its two independent characters separate H, z105=z81 iff f105^*alpha=f81^*alpha for every alpha in W.
torsor_class_exactness.consequence: At the abelian V4-torsor level, pointwise equality of the two pullbacks on W is the full torsor-class equality; there is no hidden additional H-valued class beyond the two character classes.

odd_degree_symplectic_setup.operator_orientation: T=A2^dagger A1; the opposite orientation is T^dagger

sufficiency_construction.hypotheses: Let T:V->V satisfy T|W=id and T^dagger|W=id.
sufficiency_construction.rank_beta_bound: Since W subset rad(beta) and dim(V/W)=2, rank(beta)<=2.
sufficiency_construction.auxiliary_space: Choose a 2-dimensional symplectic F2-space E and B:V->E with B|W=0 and <Bx,By>_E=beta(x,y); rank zero uses B=0, rank two uses the induced symplectic form on V/rad(beta).
sufficiency_construction.ambient_small: U0=V orthogonal_direct_sum E, so dim U0<=6.
sufficiency_construction.equal_on_W: For w in W, T w=w and B w=0, hence A1_0(w)=A2_0(w).
sufficiency_construction.ambient_capacity: dim H^1(D,F2)>=212 >> 6, so U0 embeds symplectically into H^1(D,F2) for every r=0..28.
sufficiency_construction.result: Every exact-W operator T is compatible with a pair of symplectic pullback embeddings having the full H-torsor equality on W. Hence full V4 cohomology cannot refine the 16 exact-W residues, and in particular cannot remove any of the three transvection survivors.

nielsen_boundary.separate_degree105_tuple: A Nielsen tuple for f105 records a transitive permutation representation of pi1(C2 minus B105) and a sheet stabilizer subgroup.
nielsen_boundary.separate_degree81_tuple: Likewise for f81 with its own branch locus and sheet marking.
nielsen_boundary.missing_simultaneous_marking: To compare f105^*Z and f81^*Z on the same D one must identify the two presentations of pi1(D) and compare the restrictions of the fixed alpha:pi1(C2)->H. Separate Nielsen tuples do not contain that common identification.
nielsen_boundary.rule: Do not turn separate Hurwitz realizability into simultaneous pair-map realizability. The exact cohomological H-torsor compatibility is now proved flexible, but holomorphic simultaneous realization remains a stronger geometric problem.

decision.reopen_condition: Reopen Nielsen matching only after source-locking a common pi1(D) marking, paired branch-support/conjugacy data, or another invariant of the simultaneous pair that is not determined by A1|W=A2|W.

breadth_audit.trigger: The full H-torsor condition becomes cohomologically flexible and the previous separate-Nielsen route would otherwise park at missing simultaneous markings.

generated_views.reason: The common H-torsor produces a common degree-four etale lift Dtilde->D and two H-equivariant maps Dtilde->Z=X(8). Decomposing J(Z) into H-character/Prym pieces may retain information discarded by the base H^1 plane W and by the Rosati fixed-plane compression.
Separate tuples cannot compare the two restricted H classes on the same pi1(D).
The retained H-torsor is exponent two and no canonical Z/4 lift or coefficientwise ramification profile is source-locked; do not manufacture a secondary invariant.
05W gives an explicit sufficiency construction from the exact-W hypotheses.
Decisive reconstruction remains owned by EX2 and should be imported only through an exact adapter.

next_route.selection_reason: 05W proves the full abelian V4 torsor class is already flexible once exact-W is satisfied. The closest distinct non-reconstruction view is to lift both maps to the common H-cover and inspect nontrivial H-character/Prym pieces, which are invisible in the two-dimensional base plane W.
